storyMilestones.title: Where It All Began
storyMilestones.description: It all started at the office, right in the middle of busy schedules and daily deadlines. What began as casual conversations, brief small talk, and shared coffee breaks slowly turned into something much more meaningful. Neither of us expected that an ordinary workplace would become the starting point of our story, yet somehow, our paths naturally aligned.

storyMilestones.title: More Than Just Colleagues
storyMilestones.description: As the months passed, familiarity grew into genuine comfort and trust. Between work routines and after-hours conversations, we realized how effortless it felt to be around each other. Before the year came to a close, we decided to step beyond being mere coworkers and officially started our journey as a couple, choosing to face every tomorrow together.

storyMilestones.title: A Sincere Promise
storyMilestones.description: Four years of growing together, supporting each other's dreams, and learning through life's ups and downs led us to a defining milestone. Surrounded by the warmth, prayers, and blessings of our beloved families, we took a meaningful step forward through our engagement—turning years of quiet certainty into a solemn promise for the future.

storyMilestones.title: The Beginning of Forever
storyMilestones.description: With the blessings of our families and the grace of Allah, our paths lead us to the moment we become husband and wife, knowing that whatever the future holds, we will face it hand in hand through every season of life. From colleagues to life partners, we are deeply grateful for every step that brought us here—and even more excited for the lifetime ahead.
